requirements_lock.resolver_command: uv pip compile --no-cache --generate-hashes --only-binary=:all: --python-version 3.11 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_35 --torch-backend cu128 --index-strategy first-index --emit-index-url

wheel_footprint.method: Compatible wheel sizes from PyPI release metadata and the official PyTorch cu128 index; source wheels are not vendored.
wheel_footprint.note: These are compressed download sizes, not installed-size guarantees. Fresh installation is too close to the 12 GiB campaign cap and requires verified reuse of existing compatible NVIDIA shared libraries.

allowed_only_when: all 15 NVIDIA distributions are present in the bootstrap host interpreter
each distribution version exactly matches the corresponding hashed lock entry
the installed package inventory resolves only to x86_64 Linux shared-library files and pure Python namespace metadata
every shared object is verified as x86_64 ELF before it is symlinked into the owned CPython 3.11 venv
nvidia_reuse_policy.otherwise: fail closed before training and write a bounded runtime inventory; never silently install another CUDA version
